description: This CSS file defines the styling and theme management variables for a React application, including light and dark themes as well as layout properties for various components.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container class for the application that centers the content and applies background and text colors based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application's logo, including size and animation properties.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Defines the header section's layout and styling, designed to hold primary content at the center of the screen.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for links within the application, particularly their color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styling for the theme toggle button that allows users to switch between light and dark themes, including hover and active states.
